generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Layer-local tests can all pass while adjacent internal seams are replaced by mocks, leaving no executable evidence that the real producer, public boundary, domain logic and durable state interoperate.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Mock the public entrypoint in the client test and bypass it in the persistence test, then compose those independent results as if one path crossed both seams.
trigger_signals: client plus public entrypoint plus persistence

reusable_control.requirement: One executed control crosses the public entrypoint and persistence while every mocked boundary is external.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: When a contract limits mocks to external boundaries, require an explicit external-mocks-only policy and one executable internal seam control before handoff.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail readiness when the internal seam control does not cross both the public entrypoint and persistence, covers fewer than two internal surfaces, or mocks a boundary classified as internal.

transfer_cases.scenario: client -> public_entrypoint -> domain -> persistence with provider transport external
consumer -> canonical_adapter -> durable_state with only remote provider mocked

skill_changes.change: Added the external-mocks-only structural prevention rule.
Validator now rejects internal mocks, missing persistence crossing and single-surface seam evidence when the policy is active.
